name: TikTok Caption Optimizer API
shortDescription: Optimize TikTok captions for hooks, hashtags, and trending signal detection
description: Analyze and optimize TikTok captions for hook strength, character limit compliance, hashtag strategy, and trending signals. Returns an optimized caption, recommended hashtags, and a scored issue list. Designed for TikTok creators, social media managers, and content automation agents targeting the short-form video audience.
